get_presentation.name: get_presentation
get_presentation.description: Get all slides from a presentation

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a Google Slides presentation by its presentation ID, returning its title and the full set of slides and their page elements. Use this to read or inspect a presentation's contents before acting on it. Read-only and idempotent. Requires the presentation ID (the string between /d/ and /edit in the URL).

refresh_sheets_charts.name: refresh_sheets_charts
refresh_sheets_charts.description: Refresh all Google Sheets charts in the presentation

presentation_id.description: The ID of the presentation, between /d and /edit

aiMetadata.description: Re-sync every embedded Google Sheets chart in a presentation to its source spreadsheet's current data, in a single batch update. Use this after the underlying Sheets data changes to bring the slide charts up to date. Not idempotent: each call issues a fresh refresh against live spreadsheet data, so repeated calls can pull different chart contents. Requires the presentation ID; charts that are not linked to Google Sheets are left untouched.

generate_from_template.name: generate_from_template
generate_from_template.description: Generate a new slide from a template

template_presentation_id.description: The ID of the templated presentation

placeholder_format.description: Choose the format of placeholders in your template

aiMetadata.description: Create a new Google Slides presentation by copying a template presentation, then substituting its placeholder tokens with supplied values. Use this for mail-merge style document generation from a reusable deck. The template's placeholder syntax must be selected (curly braces {{}} or square brackets [[]]); placeholders are discovered from the template's text and table cells, and matching is case-sensitive. Not idempotent: each call copies the template into a brand-new presentation file.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
